# The bill mirror of fx_invoice_usd_overpaid_into_cad_bank.txt: a 100.00 USD
# bill booked at 1.40, overpaid with 200.00 USD costing 274.00 CAD — 1.37.
#
# The part that clears the bill is valued at what the bill carried, 1.40, so
# 140.00 CAD of cost is consumed with it; the part overpaid was sent at 1.37,
# so the prepayment is worth 137.00 CAD. Less cash extinguishing more
# liability is a gain on this side, so the 3.00 CAD is credited.
#
# What this fixture produces:
#
#   Assets:Bank                    -274.00 CAD
#   A/P USD   100.00 USD   value 140.00 CAD   (clears the bill)
#   A/P USD   100.00 USD   value 137.00 CAD   (the prepayment, at 1.37)
#   Income:FX Gain                   -3.00 CAD  ($residual$, a gain)
#
# and `fx-balances` listing that prepayment as 100.00 USD available. A payable
# was judged by its credit side alone, so the prepayment — a debit on A/P —
# had a basis's KVPs written onto it and was then not counted at all: the book
# reported 0.00 USD available while holding 100.00 USD of vendor prepayment.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_payment_exchange_rate.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD
	type: Accounts Payable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

vendor "V-US"
	name: "US Vendor"
	currency: USD

bill "BILL-USD-OVERCAD"
	vendor_id: "V-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Parts"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
		memo: "Bill BILL-USD-OVERCAD"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 200
		account: "Assets:Bank"
		settled_amount: 274.00
		prepayment: 100
		memo: "Payment for BILL-USD-OVERCAD"
		Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
